current_freshness_policy: Hide expired/future current values; preserve independent fresh forecasts
forecast_freshness_policy: Hide expired/future forecast values; retain fresh current
stale_current_badge_policy: Original Old when any observation exists, using non-display presence marker
normal_appearance_group: weather_full_matrix and clock groups use fresh inputs
effective_data_group: freshness_mapping hides stale values before canonical rendering; not raw stale-source parity
network_and_process_side_effects: Blocked by socket overrides and audit hook
limitations: Offline synthetic comparison; not a physical device acceptance test
Finite input matrix; no claim of every possible weather value or instant
